content: Individuals with type 1 diabetes are at an elevated risk of developing autoimmune conditions, including thyroid disorders. Therefore, routine screening for thyroid dysfunction is strongly recommended in this population. Vitamin B12 deficiency is more frequently observed in individuals with type 1 diabetes, as are other autoimmune diseases such as Addison’s disease. For patients presenting with symptoms indicative of celiac disease, such as gastrointestinal disturbances, unexplained laboratory abnormalities, or clinical suspicion based on their medical history, it is advised to conduct appropriate screening for celiac disease.
